column1: # THE TWENTY-FOUR FROZEN NEGATIVE CONTROLS, EACH EXECUTED AS A FULL
# Each control has its own physical execution ID, independently
# derived adverse material, a reason-specific detector, the restored
# material digest and an absence-of-vacuity assertion.

column2: adverse_case
column9: restored_material_sha256

column2: the recorded HEAD replaced by a wrong value
column9: the detector recomputes the recorded value and compares it with the expected HEAD; it is not a status echo

column2: a frozen predecessor evidence blob replaced by a tampered copy
column9: the detector recomputes each frozen path's SHA-256 from the file ACTUAL bytes

column2: the C1 partial digest presented as the whole FOR definition
column9: the detector recomputes the whole digest and then checks every strict prefix; the adverse digest is a real prefix digest

column2: the whole range extended by ONE byte
column9: the detector recomputes the digest of the exact interval and of the one-byte extended and one-byte truncated intervals

column2: the inert v1 CSET emitter export reintroduced as a declaration
column9: the detector scans the ABI for a forbidden export DECLARATION and also requires both authorised exports to be present

column2: the CSET site counted as an independent semantic authority
column9: the detector parses the authority table and rejects a CSET row whose counts_as_authority is YES

column2: the zero discriminant declared to be an error status
column9: the detector requires the ABI to name IR_CMP_EQ as VALID and to forbid a numeric-zero error status

column2: the no-default-suffix guarantee withdrawn from the ABI
column9: the detector requires the ABI to state that unsupported kinds yield NULL and that no default suffix exists

column2: the ABI permitting the host to free the borrowed result
column9: the detector requires the ABI to state BORROWED, the MUST NOT free rule and the NUL-termination

column2: an expected symbol that the object does not define
column9: the detector reads the object's OWN nm symbol table and requires a global text definition

column2: the selector-ON production object asserted to be the clean C oracle
column9: the detector runs the REAL nm -u over the object and rejects either A64 import

column2: the selector-OFF G0 oracle object asserted to carry NO legacy C table
column9: the detector reads the object's OWN strings; the LIVE expectation requires the legacy literal to be present

column2: the subject object asserted to define a symbol it does not
column9: the detector reads the object's OWN nm symbol table and requires the definition

column2: an ignored Error 127 from a lost shell continuation
column9: the detector rejects a log carrying a command-not-found marker and requires the expected marker to be present

column2: a subject asserted to be imported by a caller that does not import it
column9: the detector runs the REAL nm -u over the CALLER object and requires the import

column2: the selector-ON production object asserted to still carry the legacy C table
column9: the detector reads the object's OWN strings; the DORMANT expectation requires the legacy literal to be ABSENT

column2: a PolyC producer digest aliased to another producer
column9: the detector parses the producer table and rejects two rows with the SAME digest

column2: the PAIR roster replaced by a second copy of the FROZEN roster
column9: the detector requires a roster column, exactly 12 PAIR members, exactly 12 FROZEN members and NO shared id

column2: a single fixture row deleted from the derived fixture set
column9: the detector recomputes the row count, requires every id to be UNIQUE and requires both the FOR and the INV role partitions

column2: the FOR causal evidence claimed for the INV site
column9: the detector requires the evidence file to name the REQUIRED site id

column2: the FOR dormancy evidence claimed for the INV site
column9: the detector requires the evidence to name the site id AND to record both the OFF and the ON observations

column2: the CSET adapter's fixed format changed
column9: the detector extracts the named function's WHOLE body from the live source and requires the token

column2: an acceptance id dropped from the ledger
column9: the detector rejects a MISSING id, a DUPLICATED id, an UNKNOWN id, an illegal status and a PASS row with no evidence reference

column2: AC50 claimed PASS before the external receipt exists
column9: the detector requires an AC50 PASS to carry an external-receipt reference bound to the exact expected HEAD and TREE

column1: NC_VACUITY=NONE (every control alters a real source-derived fact, a real object, a real ledger or a real build graph, and the detector RECOMPUTES that fact; no control edits a status word)
NC_DETECTOR=build/a64-cmp-cc-red-verify (compiled PolyC, linked against the real libtos)
